title: Why Connectors Matter
text:
Linking words help readers follow an argument. They show how one idea connects to another. For example, however signals a contrast, while therefore shows a result. Without these words, a text can feel like a list of unrelated facts.

Students often use connectors incorrectly. They may write however to add extra information instead of showing a contrast. They also sometimes repeat the same word, such as and, many times. Using a variety of connectors makes writing clearer and more academic.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does 'therefore' show?
According to the second paragraph, what do students sometimes do wrongly?
options: They repeat the same connector many times

questions.text: What can be inferred about a text that has no linking words?
options: It may be hard for readers to follow the connections between ideas
It is always more academic than other texts
It must be a scientific report
It contains more facts than other texts

questions.text: Why does the author recommend using a variety of connectors?
options: To make writing clearer and more academic

vocabulary.definition: words that link ideas, sentences or paragraphs together
a clear difference between two ideas or things
relating to university study and formal scholarly writing

paragraph_translations: Bağlayıcı kelimeler okuyucuların bir argümanı takip etmesine yardımcı olur. Bu kelimeler bir fikrin diğerine nasıl bağlandığını gösterir. Örneğin, however bir karşıtlığa, therefore ise bir sonuca işaret eder. Bu kelimeler olmadan bir metin, ilgisiz gerçeklerin bir listesi gibi hissettirebilir.

Öğrenciler bağlayıcıları sık sık yanlış kullanır. Örneğin, bir karşıtlık yerine ek bilgi eklemek için however yazabilirler. Ayrıca and gibi aynı kelimeyi birçok kez tekrarlayabilirler. Çeşitli bağlayıcılar kullanmak yazıyı daha net ve akademik hale getirir.
